about: Metal Slug Tactics brings the explosive charm and nostalgic fun of the cult METAL SLUG series to the tactical scene. Get ready for an intense ride through the best of both worlds: classic arcade action and roguelite tactical thrills.
Jump into the combat zone and revive your METAL SLUG nostalgia in a whole new way!

Metal Slug Tactics offers a fresh perspective on the iconic battles of the METAL SLUG series. Lead your squad to victory through strategic guile and superior firepower in a perfect blend of classic action and tactical depth.
Unleash powerful special attacks and shape the outcome of each encounter!
summary: Discover the first tactical RPG of the METAL SLUG series!
